items.source: Creates a new ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperationBuilder to define a field for the AggregationExpression.
items.translation: 创建一个新 ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperationBuilder 来定义一个字段，用于 AggregationExpression。

items.source: Creates an extended ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperation that combines ReplaceRootOperation.ReplacementDocuments from the currentOperation and extension operation.
items.translation: 创建一个扩展的ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperation，该操作将当前操作和扩展操作中的ReplaceRootOperation.ReplacementDocument合并在一起。
创建一个空的ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperation。

items.source:
Encapsulates the aggregation framework $replaceRoot-operation to result in a composable replacement document.
Instances of ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperation yield empty upon construction and can be populated with single values and documents.
items.translation:
封装聚合框架中的 `$replaceRoot` 操作，以生成可组合的替换文档。
ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperation 类的实例在构造时为空，可以通过单个值和文档进行填充。

items.source: Creates a new ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperation that merges all existing replacement values with values from value.
items.translation: 创建一个新ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperation，该操作将合并所有现有的替换值与来自 value 的值。

items.source: Creates a new ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperation that merges all existing replacement values with values from value. Existing replacement values are overwritten.
items.translation: 创建一个新的ReplaceRootOperation.ReplaceRootDocumentOperation，该操作将现有的所有替换值与来自 value 的值进行合并。现有的替换值将被覆盖。
